import json, sys; sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from harness import ktest, obj, run

# struct and array results, and int widths
types = [
  {"name": "I1", "kind": "int", "bits": 1},
  {"name": "I9", "kind": "int", "bits": 9},
  {"name": "I17", "kind": "int", "bits": 17},
  {"name": "I33", "kind": "int", "bits": 33},
  {"name": "I64", "kind": "int", "bits": 64},
  {"name": "Pair", "kind": "struct", "fields": [["a", "I9"], ["b", "I1"]]},
  {"name": "Arr", "kind": "array", "element": "Pair", "size": 2},
  {"name": "Void", "kind": "void"},
]
modules = [
  {"name": "agg", "params": [["a", "I1"], ["b", "I9"], ["c", "I17"], ["d", "I33"], ["e", "I64"]],
   "result": ["out", "Arr"], "requires": None},
  {"name": "vv", "params": [["a", "I1"]], "result": ["out", "Void"], "requires": None},
]
doc = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": ["agg", "vv"],
       "machine": None, "runs": []}
g = run(doc)
print(json.dumps(g["plans"][0]))
print(json.dumps(g["plans"][1]))
assert g["plans"][0]["slots"] == [
  ["x0", ["a"], 1], ["x1", ["b"], 2], ["x2", ["c"], 4], ["x3", ["d"], 8], ["x4", ["e"], 8],
  ["x7", ["out", 0, "a"], 2], ["x8", ["out", 0, "b"], 1],
  ["x10", ["out", 1, "a"], 2], ["x11", ["out", 1, "b"], 1]]
assert g["plans"][0]["variables"] == 12
assert g["plans"][1]["slots"] == [["x0", ["a"], 1]] and g["plans"][1]["variables"] == 1
print("PASS widths and aggregate result layout")

objs = [obj("x0", 1, 1), obj("x1", 300, 2), obj("x2", 60000, 4), obj("x3", 1 << 32, 8),

doc["runs"] = [{"entry": "agg", "ktest": ktest(objs)},

assert g["records"][0] == {"status": "READY", "case": 0,

assert g["records"][1] == {"status": "READY", "case": 1, "model_result": None}
assert g["corpus"][1]["inputs"] == {"a": False}
